title: A strategic roadmap for an atomistic machine-learning ecosystem
abstract: arXiv:2609.39090v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data-driven machine learning (ML) techniques have become an essential tool in many domains of science. Their application to atomistic simulations of matter is particularly widespread and impactful. This success is due largely to the existence of a well-developed and established physics-based modeling framework, ranging from first-principles electronic-structure calculations to molecular dynamics and statistical sampling, into which ML was integrated naturally to reshape long-standing trade-offs between accuracy, efficiency, and scale. Nevertheless, this integration raises both conceptual and practical challenges, from choosing between data-centric and physics-based modeling approaches to adapting established software stacks to modern hardware accelerators and ML libraries. translated_title: 原子尺度机器学习生态系统的战略路线图
translated_abstract: 数据驱动的机器学习（ML）技术已成为众多科学领域的重要工具，其在物质原子尺度模拟中的应用尤为广泛且影响深远。这一成功很大程度上归功于一个成熟且完善的基于物理的建模框架的存在——从第一性原理电子结构计算到分子动力学和统计抽样——机器学习被自然地融入其中，重塑了精度、效率与规模之间长期存在的权衡。然而，这种整合也带来了概念和实践层面的双重挑战，既需要在以数据为中心和基于物理的建模方法之间做出选择，又需要将既有软件栈适配到现代硬件加速器和机器学习库上。随着该领域在广泛热情和切实影响的共同推动下快速发展，当下正是回顾该领域现状并思考未来发展方向的恰当时机。
tldr: 本文为原子尺度机器学习生态系统制定了一份战略路线图，系统回顾了机器学习与基于物理的原子模拟框架深度整合所取得的成就，并探讨了在建模方法选择、软硬件适配等方面面临的挑战与未来发展方向。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a strategic roadmap for an atomistic machine-learning ecosystem, reviewing how ML has reshaped accuracy-efficiency-scale trade-offs in physics-based atomistic simulations and outlining the conceptual and practical challenges shaping the field's future development.
